answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the shale is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the sonnet of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. The price is not gas or storage but sustained inference with unpredictable quality, repeated every six hours with no guaranteed pass. That makes the voyage expensive rather than free. Seal 1op81.
